original_title: China’s Inflation Cools as Iran War Oil Shock Starts to Ease
title: China’s Inflation Cools as Iran War Oil Shock Starts to Ease
original_summary: China’s factory-gate inflation eased for the first time since the Iran war broke out in late February while consumer prices also decelerated, in another sign that cost pressures from the oil shock are starting to fade.
